notes.title: Devlog (Chapter 8)
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,  Here’s a quick update on development progress. A bit more than half of Chapter 8 is now complete. I’m now following a new schedule, planning to release updates approximately every two months. If all goes well, Chapter 8 should be ready in about three-four weeks.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514528/d495b6092a751a0505dec543e0f0d7921dbfb6ca.png"][/img]
I’m also happy to share some improvements regarding the animations. I’ve started working with a specialist who focuses exclusively on animations and creates them in Blender, which has noticeably raised the overall quality. In my opinion, these new animations are among the best I’ve seen in visual novels created with DAZ.

[url="https://mega.nz/file/UAJ1UKAI#XiVw8RMZzZqglVZIpgeqfxZkz-ylvjCt9qqYCSIrooY"]First preview[/url][/p][p][url="https://mega.nz/file/RIo1FQgL#uT1fwJb4ADYDbAG4E3QcBnDJcsns4M5Jk1xeQIWyZB0"]Second preview[/url][/p][p]

Below you’ll also find some fresh screenshots and previews from the upcoming chapter.

Thanks for your interest and support—more updates will be coming soon!

notes.title: Development Update: Chapter 7 Completed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
[img]https://i.ibb.co/whd0cLN1/74-45.jpg[/img]
I wanted to share a status update on the development of the next season of With Eyes Closed. The seventh chapter is now complete, marking another step forward toward the full release of the new season.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/wNs1tGLG/72-20.jpg[/img]
This chapter features a dangerous rescue mission, tense confrontations, and several key revelations that may challenge your trust in certain heroines. There are also new characters with their own motives and secrets, as well as opportunities for both passionate and tender romantic moments—depending on your choices. You’ll visit new locations, encounter heated arguments, and experience plenty of suspense as the story continues to unfold.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/GfPJ6Ts0/73-23.jpg[/img]
Content of Chapter 7:

360 new renders
17,000 words
30 animations
[img]https://i.ibb.co/1f8VJCfy/67-11.jpg[/img]
If you’d like more detailed updates and insights about the current status of the second season, you can find them [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/chapter-7-is-now-128550716]on my Patreon[/url].

Thank you for following the development progress. More updates will be posted here as work continues!

notes.title: Poll: Your Thoughts on Anal Scenes in the Game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As I continue to develop new content for With Eyes Closed, I want to ensure that the game aligns with both my vision and your preferences. I’d appreciate your feedback on the inclusion of anal scenes in the game. How do you feel about this type of content? Your responses will help guide how often these scenes appear in future chapters.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3TVRB9P/67-10.jpg[/img]

Since Steam doesn’t offer a direct polling feature, I invite you to share your thoughts either by commenting below or by voting on [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/your-thoughts-on-124401074]my Patreon[/url].
